code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated D-dimer, INR, ferritin, LDH, CRP, and mild renal impairment (elevated urea/creatinine). These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and coagulopathy. The pattern may be seen in severe infection (e.g., viral pneumonia/COVID-19), with risk for multi-organ involvement. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
